errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Gateway operation or binding authorization denied
errors.HOST_MISMATCH: authenticated Host differs from stored or selected Host
errors.AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: current role or service authority cannot be verified
errors.ROLE_NOT_CURRENT: no current membership in exact Host and role
errors.BINDING_NOT_READY: expected saved revision is not active at Gateway
errors.DEFINITION_PIN_MISMATCH: saved definition digest differs from active binding
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: schema or supported task validation failed
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: same idempotency key with different accepted input
errors.ACCEPTANCE_UNCONFIRMED: start outcome requires authorized same-key recovery
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: expected lifecycle or assignment version differs
errors.CLAIM_CONFLICT: assignment has a winning active claim
errors.TASK_EXPIRED: human assignment is expired or inactive
errors.APPROVAL_LINK_PENDING: accepted approval is fenced until Portal linkage is confirmed
errors.APPROVAL_STALE: request, grant pins, role or linkage became stale
errors.DECISION_PENDING_DELIVERY: Workflow decision is durable but Portal has not committed
errors.PROCESS_NOT_TERMINAL: native process or invocation has not reached a terminal state
errors.RESOURCE_HELD: outstanding task, job, action, feature or approval delivery prevents deletion
errors.LEGAL_HOLD: the logical deletion is recorded while held artifacts remain retained
